subject: ACE registration & cost responsibility kickoff — MedPulse Marketplace
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medpulse.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACE registration & next steps for MedPulse

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers and how prefix caching could help our triage workflows. We want to move forward with ACE registration and explore an AWS co-sell path. A few things we need clarity on from your side before we loop in our AWS PDM:

- Who owns the marketplace listing costs and quoting for a co-sell (Redwood or MedPulse)?
- Do you have a recommended AWS intake form (we have some internal procurement gating items)?
- Can Redwood provide a short checklist of data/attachments AWS will expect during ACE intake?

I've attached the intake form our procurement team uses (PDF) and a short checklist. Can we do a 30-min sync this week to align PDM/PSM responsibilities and cost ownership?

Proposed times: Tue 4/14 at 10:00am PT or Wed 4/15 at 11:00am PT.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedPulse Health

Attachments: MP-AWS-ACE-Form.pdf, MedPulse-Onboarding-Checklist.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medpulse.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration & next steps for MedPulse

Liam — thanks for the clear list and for sharing the procurement doc. Happy to run the sync. Short answers up front:

- Marketplace listing costs: typically, the seller (Redwood) covers the listing fees and maintains the listing. Co-sell credits/marketing spend are negotiated per-deal; we can propose a co-funded pilot to offset initial marketplace listing promos.
- AWS intake form: we have an ACE intake checklist and a filled example that helps shorten AWS review cycles. I attached our "MedPulse Marketplace Checklist" (spreadsheet) and an example ACE intake we completed for another healthcare customer (redacted).
- PDM/PSM roles: for AWS co-sell, we usually introduce the customer's procurement POC to our Seller PDM and our Solutions PSM for joint readiness calls; PDM owns AWS-side intake coordination, PSM owns technical readiness and enablement for go-to-market materials.

Can we book Tue 4/14 10:00am PT — I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: 1) ACE intake docs review, 2) cost & promo ownership, 3) PDM/PSM intro and immediate asks.

Action items I will take before the call:
- Share MedPulse-Marketplace-Checklist.xlsx (attached)
- Drop in the AWS ACE example (redacted)
- Confirm which Redwood contacts will attend (PDM + PSM)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Partner Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: MedPulse-Marketplace-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-ACE-Example.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medpulse.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: PDM/PSM intros and internal cost notes

Kimberly / Liam — looping in the folks from our seller side.

- Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — Seller PDM (AWS liaison) — will own ACE intake coordination and AWS-side handoffs.
- Priya Natarajan (priya_natarajan@redwood.com) — Solutions PSM — will handle technical readiness, marketplace packaging guidance, and the enablement checklist.

Quick notes on cost/quote responsibilities so we’re explicit before the call:
- Listing fees & marketplace admin: Redwood covers the AWS listing registration fees.
- Joint go-to-market credits (co-marketing/co-sell credits): typically split and documented in the co-sell plan; we will propose a $15k co-marketing pilot for initial visibility if MedPulse is open.
- Marketplace transaction fees and end-customer billing: governed by AWS marketplace rules; commercial terms (who invoices whom) are captured in the listing configuration — we should agree how MedPulse prefers to receive billing (direct or via Redwood reseller model).

Karthik — can you prepare a short slide with the ACE intake timeline and key AWS artifacts AWS will ask for (tech diagram, SOC/certs, billing model preference)? Priya — please prepare the enablement checklist for product listing (short descriptions, screenshots, sample billing flows).

I accepted Kim's proposed time for Tue 4/14 10:00am PT. Calendar invite coming.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medpulse.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration & next steps for MedPulse

On Tue, Apr 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Liam — thanks for the clear list and for sharing the procurement doc. Happy to run the sync. Short answers up front:
>
> - Marketplace listing costs: typically, the seller (Redwood) covers the listing fees...

Great sync today — thanks everyone for time and clarity. Notes/next steps (short):

1) ACE intake package (owner: Karthik) — I uploaded the slide deck and a checklist to the shared drive (link below). AWS expects: architecture diagram, data flow and configs, security attestations (SOC2 + encryption notes), and preferred billing model. Target: submit ACE intake to AWS by 2026-04-22.
2) Co-marketing pilot (owner: Kimberly + Liam) — Kimberly to propose the $15k pilot and draft a brief co-marketing outline for review by Friday 4/16.
3) Procurement & billing preference (owner: Liam + Procurement) — MedPulse to confirm whether they want to invoice customers directly or accept billing via Redwood's marketplace configuration. Deadline: 4/20.
4) Technical readiness (owner: Priya) — PSM will provide sample listing assets and a one-page runbook for integration tests.

Attachments uploaded: MedPulse-Marketplace-Checklist.xlsx, AWS-ACE-Submission-Slides.pdf
Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bMP-AWS-ACE
HubSpot record: HS-987654321

I'll draft the intake submission and share a first pass with Kimberly before we hit submit.

—Karthik
Seller PDM, Redwood Inference
